about: Round 07, 2026-09-23 — setup, the first of the founder's small rounds ("start first round now": rounds of 10–12 on one topic, each asked twice, graded by Claude before he reads them). Every question is a real one from production, in the asker's words, never used in a round before: seven of the founder's own (July–September) on his current A800RR, and five on testers' cars — Jayden Edmonds' Sparko F8SE 1/8 nitro buggy (sheet filled but not readable yet), Glenn Wilson's A800R (readable), Robbie Storey's AMX3 on the A800RR sheet (readable), and Ant's Yokomo MS2.1 (nothing on the sheet). A tester's question runs on THAT tester's run, the one the Engineer answered about: their captures are their data, so fixtures/private-*.txt are git-excluded (.git/info/exclude) and never committed — re-capture with capture-run-fixture.ts --email <theirs> --run <id> (ids in the ledger's round 07 entry). Run one context at a time: --contexts <context> --only <its ids>.
